about: Edit scripts for the Week 2 footage Vish filmed on 25 and 26 Oct (Drive folder 'week 2 raw talk', local copies in video-projects/week-02-talks/raw, gitignored). Written 27 Oct from what he really said, so the captions follow his words. Times are seconds in each clip, from faster-whisper word times (work/transcripts.json); every cut snaps to the quietest 10 ms nearby. 'vish' is his real take; 'clone' is his ElevenLabs clone ('Young indian male'), at most 2 lines a reel, never the hook; 'narrator' is the v12 'Next week' card voice. B-roll queries go to movingimagearchive.com (public domain, credits kept per project) unless the source is his own clip.

edits.title: Week 2 of 52
edits.post: Instagram Reel + Shorts, Sun 2 Nov 18:30; LinkedIn 4:5 Fri 7 Nov
edits.hook: 220 companies said *no*. // So I'm building my own job.

beats.say: 220 companies have said no, so I'm building my own job.
beats.see: Freeze on 'no' (2.96 s): shutter, he becomes the white-outlined sticker; labels pop on: '220 rejections', 'Week 2 of 52'. Words behind his head.
beats.sound: shutter, pops climbing in pitch, then a hard silence on 'no'

beats.say: Let's rewind.
beats.see: Tape-rewind scramble through 4 frames of the Week 1 reel (its real stills: the 40K odometer, '0 job offers')

beats.say: The main goal of this challenge is to make 3,000 euros per month
beats.see: Goal meter card behind him: €0 / €3,000 a month, the bar empty
beats.sound: counter ticks to 3,000, a soft thud

beats.say: so I could work from here, or in Bali, or anywhere.
beats.see: 'here': his own walk clip (IMG_8742, 0 to 1 s, the street). 'Bali': archive card, 'tropical beach with palm trees' (year label on the frame). 'anywhere': archive card, 'old world map with a travelling plane'
beats.sound: a whoosh per card, the bed opens up

beats.say: Hi! Before we start the week 2 video, come with me. Let's get a haircut.
beats.see: Full-frame mirror selfie; then the haircut in 4 quick cuts on the beat (IMG_8694 shop, 8695 basin, 8696 cape, 8697 after), 0.7 s each
beats.sound: clipper buzz, scissor snips, the music up for 3 s

beats.say: The first thing I realised before jumping into the ocean directly: the first thing I should do is reduce friction.
beats.see: On 'jumping into the ocean': archive card, 'man diving off a pier into the sea'. On 'reduce friction': the title types on behind him
beats.sound: a splash on the dive, type clicks

beats.say: So what that means is creating profiles on all the freelancing platforms, creating my portfolio, third would be creating a plan, a plan for what my content looks like
beats.see: Split layout: a 3-row checklist above him. Each row ticks as he says it: 1 Profiles, 2 Portfolio, 3 Plan

beats.say: I don't have a tripod. I don't have a mic.
beats.see: Two archive cards struck through: 'film camera on a tripod', 'old studio microphone'

beats.say: Not going super fancy, not investing thousands of euros before earning them.
beats.see: A big line behind him: '€0 before €1'

beats.say: So this week: profiles, portfolio, plan. Comment FRICTION and I'll send you my checklist.
beats.see: Back on him (a held, silent frame from IMG_8744 at 28.3 s), the 3 rows tick again in one sweep, the comment bubble with FRICTION

beats.say: Next week, on Build with Vish: did reducing friction work?
beats.see: The v12 cream 'Next week' card; the 52-week bar fills week 3; 'Follow for week 3'

edits.notes: The 40K stays without a currency until Vish confirms it, so it shows only as the Week 1 still. 'Bali' is a place he names, not a trip: the card is labelled as archive footage with its year. FRICTION needs its guide and a config.json entry before the post goes up.

edits.title: Reduce friction (teaching reel)
edits.post: Optional Reel for Week 3 (the carousel M1 leads on Tue 4 Nov). Uses the same takes as WEEK2, so it never runs in the same week.
edits.hook: Before jumping into the ocean, // reduce friction.

beats.say: Before jumping into the ocean directly, the first thing I should do is reduce friction.
beats.see: Archive: 'man diving off a pier into the sea', frozen mid-air as the title lands behind him

beats.say: Friction is anything that stands between you and a yes.
beats.see: Greg Isenberg paper desk: a dark card reading 'FRICTION' with three locks on it

beats.say: So what that means is creating profiles on all the freelancing platforms, creating my portfolio,
beats.see: Lock 1 opens: a profile card. Lock 2 opens: a portfolio page

beats.say: third would be creating a plan, a plan for what my content looks like, what are the ways I'm going to make my skills into something which people will pay for.
beats.see: Lock 3 opens: a calendar page; then 'skills → paid' as two cards joined by a cable

beats.say: Comment FRICTION and I'll send you the checklist, with three Claude prompts.
beats.see: The comment box, FRICTION typed key by key
